input: Interview three interior designers before committing

gold.taskTitle: Interview Three Interior Designers Before Committing
gold.taskDescription: Research and interview three interior designers to evaluate them before hiring one for a project.

questions.title: What type of space are you redesigning?
questions.description: Identify whether the project involves a home, office, rental unit, or another type of space.

questions.title: Which specific rooms or areas need to be designed?
questions.description: Clarify the exact scope — full home, single room, open-plan area, etc.

questions.title: What is your total budget for the design project?
questions.description: Understand the financial ceiling so designers can be filtered by fit.

questions.title: Do you already have any designer candidates in mind?
questions.description: Find out if the user has leads or needs to start sourcing designers from scratch.

questions.title: What style or aesthetic are you trying to achieve?
questions.description: Capture the visual direction — minimalist, maximalist, Scandinavian, industrial, etc.

questions.title: When do you need the project completed by?
questions.description: Establish the end deadline to work backwards and set urgency for the interview process.

questions.title: What matters most when choosing your final designer?
questions.description: Identify the top deciding factor — price, portfolio style, communication, referrals, etc.
